scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @juvantage/shared && npm run dev -w @juvantage/desktop
scripts.dev:ui: npm run build -w @juvantage/shared && npm run dev:ui -w @juvantage/desktop
scripts.dev:os: npm run build -w @juvantage/shared && concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,teal "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui -w @juvantage/desktop"
scripts.dev:os-electron: npm run build -w @juvantage/shared && concurrently -k -n api,desktop -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w @juvantage/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @juvantage/shared && npm run build -w @juvantage/api && npm run build -w @juvantage/desktop
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @juvantage/shared && npm run build -w @juvantage/api && npx tsc -p apps/desktop --noEmit
